topic: Several states, or a state and the nation, in one question
situation (example wording): "Carjackings in Texas and Ohio in 2024", "carjackings in Texas and the United States by year".
what the app does today: Declined: a state or the nation together with other places.
proposed behavior: One table with a Place column and a row for each place (and for each year or category when asked). Each place is its own state sum with its own coverage and evidence; places are never added together, and a rate is never summed across places. A state with an agency or county, a clearance share, Homicide Reports details, and Consistent Reporting Agencies for several places stay declined.
exact default or choices offered: Rows in the order the places were named.
why: The Coordinator, 2026-11-23: build the state or nation beside named places on its own branch; Jeff's goal is 100% of the logged labels.
status: Built on branch nibrs-engine/state-beside-places; waits on the Runner's full gate and a Claude counting review. No change to compile.ts.
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts (P270 block): Texas and Ohio carjackings 2024 give [Texas 307, Ohio 120]; Texas and the United States give two rows; Houston and Texas, a clearance share for two states, and Texas named twice decline.
